IL‐6 expression and production by peripheral blood mononucleated cells from patients with Common Variable Immunodeficiency are increased, but that the cells do not respond with increased production of Immunoglobulin.

the study of the role of cytokines in the pathogenesis of common variable immunodeficiencies.
the study of the role of IL‐6 in the pathogenesis of the common variable immunodeficiencies (CVI).

the increased IL‐6 production in CVI is not responsible for the defective humoral immune response in CVI.
